description: SP-15 (Claude Code 2.1.301), 15 §4.2 Resume / identity, ADR-015 item 7: the recording holds three processes one after another (launch, resume, fork), split by the spawned marks of its timing stream; each process replays its own part. The launch with --session-id <id> ends (its output ends: transport-lost, then exited). resume() spawns claude with --resume <id>, no --session-id and nothing on stdin; claude writes nothing before its first stdin line (S-020-1), so the resume is ready once the 3 s early-failure window passed without an error result or an exit. The next turn goes on stdin; its system/init names the same session id, so the ref keeps it and has no previousProviderSessionId; that turn ends at 3 000 ms on the fake clock, after the window. The fork part (--fork-session, which this driver never passes) is the recorded shape of a resume that minted a new id: replayed as a resume, its system/init names another id, which becomes providerSessionId with previousProviderSessionId the old one (the driver test asserts it). Claude does not replay earlier messages on stream-json, so the resumed process adds only the new turn.
